comparison_class.definition: Single-name option chains with a put/call volume ratio between 0.75 and 0.95 and front-month IV above 35%
comparison_class.why_this_class: nearest available analogue from the current skew/ratio regime, direction lean treated cautiously per this seat's mandate

thesis: The put/call volume ratio of 0.87 is modestly call-skewed but not extreme. Front-month implied volatility near 36-38% implies roughly a 7% one-week expected move via the ATM straddle -- this expected-move figure is this seat's primary contribution and should anchor every other seat's price target. Term structure between the two listed expiries is roughly flat, suggesting no acute near-dated event is being priced beyond the already-known earnings date. Directional lean is weak and should be weighted lightly relative to the expected-move output.

key_evidence.claim: ATM implied volatility ~36-38% across listed strikes

what_would_change_my_mind: A sharp steepening of the put skew or a spike in front-month IV disproportionate to the back month would shift this seat toward a defensive lean.
